verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly say it can implement entirely new features from tickets, and other docs support the workflow around it: delegating complex tasks for a first draft and iterating on CI failures via Auto-Fix. However, nothing documents Devin writing tests as part of that work. Community reports (a 13.8% issue-resolution figure, demos described as short and limited in scope) point to limits on depth but do not concretely contradict the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Devin writes tests, evidence of end-to-end feature delivery including a test suite, independent hands-on corroboration of successful feature implementation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent implement a requested feature end-to-end, including writing tests

citations.quote: implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!
Delegating a more complex task via the web application and taking over in Devin’s IDE once it gives you a good first draft.
fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
